(5) Back on the ground, she walks along a brick pathway next to the stone building, gesturing towards various doors and windows while continuing her narrative. (6) A second woman opens a wooden door from the inside, smiling and holding an action camera on a selfie stick, leading to both women laughing together as they enter the building.
